Edwardów  is a village in the administrative district of Gmina Kondratowice, within Strzelin County, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, in south-western Poland. It lies approximately  north-east of Kondratowice,  west of Strzelin, and  south of the regional capital Wrocław.
